generations.name: First generation (J1)
generations.notes: e-tron GT quattro and RS e-tron GT on Porsche's J1 platform (Taycan sibling): 93.4 kWh gross / 83.7 kWh usable, 270 kW DC, 800 V. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_e-tron_GT

generations.name: 2025 update
generations.notes: Refresh shared with the 2025 Taycan: 105 kWh gross / 97 kWh usable pack, up to 320 kW DC. Lineup renamed S e-tron GT and RS e-tron GT performance (EPA base models "S e-tron" and "RS e-tron"). Confidence: medium-high (Wikipedia has no facelift figures; values from general press coverage of the refresh, to be fact-checked) (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_e-tron_GT
